_help: User's taste profile. Self-replicates the project's aesthetic compass — anyone cloning the repo gets the same compass. Edit by user feedback, by `/aesthetic_test` ratings, or by manual edit. Read by mutate.py and theatrical_tick.py at every tick to bias generation toward likes and away from dislikes.

directions: differential growth (organic, self-avoiding, recognizable form, can be 2D or 3D)
vertical / upward-growing forms (5gm tower direction)
real-world point clouds with recognizable silhouette (Lucy statue, head scan with proper framing)
strange attractors with clear mathematical shape (Lorenz butterfly, Aizawa vortex)
mathematical shape that emerges from rules (L-system tree, voronoi)
biomorphism — vascular, mycelial, coral, anatomical
architecture — arabesque, stacked setbacks, columns, ribbons
language as form — calligraphy, script, glyphs as compositional material
audio-reactive with structured response (8ug audio shells)
morphing / multi-stage pieces with click-cycled states
single-color or restrained duotone palettes (cream-on-ink, gold-on-midnight, purple-on-black)
lit forms (MeshStandardMaterial with key+rim+ambient) when curvature should read as anatomy
Burning Man emotional infrastructure — incomplete figures seeking completion
lines / threads / planes as alternatives to point sprites

CatmullRomCurve3 + variable-radius swept tube for ink/vascular renders
InstancedMesh of small planes for color-field accumulation
L-system + 3D turtle for procedural organic forms
two-pose lerp for morph pieces (kam cypress↔tower, hn4 two-faces)

principles: shape comes from the field/equation/object, not from noise
form must be recognizable — viewer should know what they're looking at
framing must follow growth — camera tracks centroid, not fixed at startup
validate render produces ≥0.5% non-background pixels before pushing
hard no-repeat: same (parent_id × directive_id) never twice
name a real artist or named technique, don't extrapolate from training priors generically
